The '''Lucky-77 Swoop speeder''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Lucky-77 Swoop speeder was a gift given to all ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' subscribers on March 18, 2014.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
